title: Finite free self Ext pullback frame on a Koszul chart
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let U be an affine open of Y, and let n,m be nonnegative integers. Let f:Fin(m)\to\Gamma(Y,U) be Koszul-regular [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] and generate the kernel ideal i.ker.ideal(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Set B=i_*\mathcal O_Z and G=H^n(R\mathcal Hom_Y(B,B)) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then the restriction of the ordinary tensor pullback i^*G [def-pc-module-pullback] to the over-i^{-1}(U) site is isomorphic to the free structure module indexed by ULift of the n-element subsets of Fin(m) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. This holds also for n=0, n>m, m=0, and empty inverse-image charts. No regularity outside U or stalk hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.4, proof: zero-differential Hom calculation and increasing contraction basis

proof.text: Apply the affine zero-differential quotient frame computation to the specified Koszul generators, obtaining an actual isomorphism between G.over U and the coproduct of copies of the pushed-forward structure module indexed by the supplied subset type.

Feed this isomorphism to the general closed-immersion quotient-frame pullback theorem. It converts the quotient-module frame into a free structure-module frame over the inverse image of U, exactly the required conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_self_ext_pullback_local_frame
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ)
    (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    Nonempty ((((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Set.powersetCard (Fin m) n)))
